name: Somchai Watanapan
bio:
Somchai's journey into motorsport began unconventionally. After a brief stint as an engineer for an automotive manufacturer, he became fascinated with the precision and relentless pursuit of improvement in racing. He transitioned into a coordinator role, leveraging his technical background to bridge the gap between drivers and engineers. He has a knack for identifying crucial areas of improvement in testing programs. 

At JHR Developments, Somchai is known for his demanding yet supportive approach. He pushes his team to extract every ounce of performance from their tests, meticulously analyzing data and offering constructive criticism. He believes in fostering a culture of open communication and constant learning, ensuring everyone is aligned with the team's objectives.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly cropped with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Somchai has a wiry build and an intense gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations
Insists on a specific brand of Thai iced coffee before every test session
Has a habit of tapping his pen rapidly when deep in thought
